div.head: Northu 24
div.ab: Gif man preost ofslea, forgilde man hine be fullan were ⁊ biscope feower ⁊ XX ór to weofodbote; æt diacone XII ór to weofodbote.

If anyone slays a priest, he is to pay compensation for him with the full wergild, and 24 ores to the bishop as compensation for [insult to] the altar; for a deacon 12 ores as compensation for [insult to] the altar.
If anyone kills a priest, compensate for him with his full wergild, and twenty-four ores to the bishop as compensation to the church; for a deacon, twelve ores as compensation to the church.
Wenn jemand einen Priester erschlägt, vergelte er ihn durch [dessen] volles Wergeld und dem Bischofe 24 Ör als Altarbusse; bei einem Diakon 12 Ör als Altarbusse.
If anyone kills a priest, let him pay for him with [his] full wergild and 24 ores to the bishop as altar-compensation; for a deacon, 12 ores as altar-compensation.
